1.DisplayText:
Dear Mommy, I was taken in by a kind family today. They even gave me my own room. It's been ages since I've laid on such a soft bed.

Later, we went out together to find some things and even saw a princess! She's so lucky... she has so many friends to play with.
Tonight, we made crystal lamps together. They sparkle like diamonds!

But I will keep our secret. I know I can only stay here for a short time, and I promise to be good.

2.DisplayText:
Today, we visited a place with so many trees, but some of them had died. It made me want to cry... The old man who plants trees said that life is a cycle, but what did he mean?

The old man gave us a little tree, all beautifully decorated. I hope it grows up to be tall and strong.

I couldn't sleep last night... It feels like it's been ages since I've had a good rest.
Goodnight, Mommy.

3.DisplayText:
Today, Uncle Thane took us to a huge desert! I've never seen so much sand!
So many beasts were chasing us! It's a day I'll never forget.
My room keeps filling up with more decorations. I can't wait to see how it turns out...

Miss Fox said Miss Leopard is her family. I wish Sister Estrilda, Uncle Thane, and Uncle Baden could be my family...

Is that possible?
Mommy, I miss you.

4.DisplayText:
I can't believe I met Isabella! I was so happy to see her, but some scary people came after us too...
But I didn't want to hide anymore, so I showed my true self.

Sister Estrilda, Uncle Baden, and Uncle Thane didn't seem upset. In fact, we worked together to drive away those scary people.

Sister Estrilda said there's no need to hold back among family. It feels so safe being with them.
Mommy, someone finally accepts me.

5.DisplayText:
Last night, I slept so well! I dreamed about you, Mommy, and my big sister and the others too.

Flora took me on her broomstick and we flew so high! Down below, Uncle Baden and the others seemed really worried, but flying on the broomstick was so much fun!

We made a crystal ball out of magic snow. It never melts, and even though it feels cool on your fingers, somehow it's not cold at all.

6.DisplayText:
Today was another big adventure! We helped Meowzers find a comfy bed where he can nap all day long.

Later, we all made a cozy fireplace together. Sitting by the fire with everyone felt so warm.

7.DisplayText:
La da dee, la dee da, la da dee, la dee da! The priest was kind of scary, but his music was soooo beautiful!

Wow, my room is already full of beautiful decorations! Midwinter Festival is so much fun!

8.DisplayText:
I hope this winter never ends.
Mommy, I've made so many new friends... and a new family too.

Sister Estrilda and Uncle Thane don't mind the Graveborn, but Uncle Baden says many humans still fear us. So after the Midwinter Festival, I'll go live with him on a small island. He says there are many others there like us, already dead and without a home.

Even though I'll be apart from Uncle Thane and Sister Estrilda, I'm not sad because we've already promised to celebrate together again next year!
Mommy, I'll remember your words and be a brave girl.
